target_customer: Real estate and infrastructure development teams, including data center, energy and logistics developers, and utilities
problem: Finding sites, judging entitlement risk and tracking permit schedules is slow and manual. PermitPortal uses AI agents and data to speed pre-construction.
business_model: B2B software plus services (platform, reports and data API); pricing not public

founders.name: Radu Mazilu
previous_startups: Listle, audio articles app (YC 2019, with the same co-founder, outcome not found)
founders.background_notes: Previously developed 700MW of clean energy projects in Europe per YC page. YC page mentions a co-founder of 7 years but gives no name.

competitors.name: PermitFlow
competitors.what: AI permitting software for construction firms
competitors.funding_then: Seed of 5.5M dollars in 2023 per a news report

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregating zoning and jurisdiction data and layering LLM analysis is standard engineering, with data coverage as the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: Jurisdiction scoring and local sentiment data could compound, but zoning data vendors and other AI startups could replicate it.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Zoning and permitting vendors added AI features; no source found of a direct takeover.

market_need_then: Permitting and entitlement delay is a known cost for developers, and the data center build out raised demand for fast site screening; only secondary sources found.

branding.domain_note: permitportalapp.com (app suffix); no exact .com evidence found

brand_strength.rationale: Name is generic: many city and county sites are called Permit Portal, and it is easily confused with PermitFlow.

outcome_analysis: PermitPortal is active with no reported exit and no public funding detail. The team has repeated founders with a prior YC company, and the site now targets data center and energy developers. A generic name, a small team and a better funded permitting rival make the path uncertain.
notes: Funding: aggregators list Y Combinator, Hustle Fund, FundersClub and Rebel Fund and about 500K dollars, seen only on aggregators, so unverified and not recorded as a round. PermitFlow is a different company. Second co-founder is unnamed on the YC page. Site shifted focus later than batch; competitors that emerged later are not listed. Completeness pass: The pre-seed rests on databases only (VCBacked dates it 2024-12 with an undisclosed amount, Standout lists 500K dollars total); the amount is one aggregator's total, not confirmed by press.
